metadata.question: Does the stratospheric ozone concentration in the Arctic region (63-90 degrees North) increase in April 2014 compared to April 2011?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Need stratospheric ozone data for Arctic region (63-90°N) - Compare April 2014 vs April 2011 - Use ECMWF/CAMS/NRT or NASA ozone data products - Best option: Copernicus Atmosphere Monitoring Service (CAMS) or TOMS/OMI ozone data 2. Masking strategy: - Ozone data typically doesn't need cloud masking - Focus on total column ozone or stratospheric ozone specifically - May need to filter for valid data quality flags 3. Logic: - Valid Zero: Ozone values should be positive (Dobson Units typically 200-500) - If no data available → C1 - If data exists but all masked/invalid → C2 - If calculation fails (None/NaN) → C3 - Compare mean ozone: 2014 > 2011 → A, else → B ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const arctic = ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [[-180, 63], [180, 63], [180, 90], [-180, 90], [-180, 63]] ]); const date2011 = ee.DateRange('2011-04-01', '2011-04-30'); const date2014 = ee.DateRange('2014-04-01', '2014-04-30'); // 2. Data Acquisition - Using TOMS/OMI Ozone data let col2011 = ee.ImageCollection('TOMS/MERGED') .filterDate(date2011) .filterBounds(arctic); let col2014 = ee.ImageCollection('TOMS/MERGED') .filterDate(date2014) .filterBounds(arctic); const size2011 = col2011.size().getInfo(); const size2014 = col2014.size().getInfo(); console.log(`2011 Images: ${size2011}`); console.log(`2014 Images: ${size2014}`); if (size2011 === 0 || size2014 === 0) { console.log("Empty collection for one or both periods."); console.log("C1"); return; } // 3. Processing - Calculate mean ozone const img2011 = col2011.mean(); const img2014 = col2014.mean(); // Check pixel counts const count2011 = img2011.select('ozone').reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: arctic, scale: 50000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('ozone').getInfo(); const count2014 = img2014.select('ozone').reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: arctic, scale: 50000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('ozone').getInfo(); console.log(`2011 Valid Pixels: ${count2011}`); console.log(`2014 Valid Pixels: ${count2014}`); if (count2011 === 0 || count2014 === 0) { console.log("No valid pixels after processing."); console.log("C2"); return; } // 4. Calculate mean ozone values const ozone2011 = img2011.select('ozone').reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: arctic, scale: 50000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('ozone').getInfo(); const ozone2014 = img2014.select('ozone').reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: arctic, scale: 50000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('ozone').getInfo(); console.log(`April 2011 Mean Ozone: ${ozone2011} DU`); console.log(`April 2014 Mean Ozone: ${ozone2014} DU`); // 5. Validation & Final Answer if (ozone2011 === null || ozone2014 === null || isNaN(ozone2011) || isNaN(ozone2014) || ozone2011 < 0 || ozone2014 < 0 || ozone2011 > 1000 || ozone2014 > 1000) { console.log("Invalid ozone values detected."); console.log("C3"); return; } const increase = ozone2014 - ozone2011; console.log(`Difference (2014-2011): ${increase.toFixed(2)} DU`); if (ozone2014 > ozone2011) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
